Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
Will you let [Miss Carter Smith](../persons.html#263) as before order some of the [Scripture Readings](../books.html#87) at the price to the trade.
I wish [Clay](../others.html#173) would finish off [that last volume](../books.html#129).

He always sends me a proof when I am busy. I send more copy.

Then he stops for another 3 months. I have now finished within about 12 chapters, but I shall be in Devonshire after Tuesday for 6 weeks, however a letter here will be sent on

Yours truly

C M Yonge
